scope: Verify every generated Rust public source at the report's independently selected producer revision. Authenticate both generator entry points and their complete imported closure against the unchanged hosted archive, reproduce all four original author routes, and reject altered generated files or a different producer. Keep current installed-package generation, all original archive/model/runtime/installation assertions, and all retained evidence bytes unchanged. Full archive replay remains a hosted gate.

edits.current: * @param options.producerCommit - Independently selected full producer revision.
const { read, json, model, receipt, floor, producerCommit } = options;
edits.previous: const { read, json, model, receipt, floor } = options;

const generated = generateCopiedRustPackage(model.bindingIr, evidence, {
		name: pkg.name
		, version: pkg.version
		, metadata: compiledPackageMetadata(model.sourceIdentity)

for(const [path, source] of Object.entries(generated))
		assert.equal((await read(`package/${path}`)).toString(), source, path);

edits.current: const { pkg, crate } = await checkPackage({ read, json, model, receipt, floor, producerCommit });
edits.previous: const { pkg, crate } = await checkPackage({ read, json, model, receipt, floor });
